correctness.rationale: Direct multiplication of partial injections gives the distinct-arrow commutation criterion. The explicit adjacency operator is derived by inclusion-exclusion and diagonal removal. Its symmetric/skew splitting is invariant; skew row-sum map has image dimension n-1 and kernel dimension (n-1)(n-2)/2; symmetric (R,d) map is onto because the unsigned K_n edge-incidence matrix has full row rank for n>=3. The two 2-by-2 quotient matrices yield every characteristic factor, and sign analysis gives inertia. The standalone checker independently compares actual compositions and exact characteristic polynomials for n=3,4,5,6. The finite computations are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The minimal nonzero Green class of the universal inverse monoid provides a canonical commuting graph that is simultaneously natural in semigroup structure and graph spectrum. The complete factorization supplies the exact kernel dimension and a sharp nonsingular-to-singular transition, as well as fixed positive inertia 2n, neither inferred from known clique/diameter or full-rook zero-product inertia results. The theorem holds for all set sizes n>=3 and is not an arbitrary finite slice.
